The '''Solaest system''' was located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] linked it to the [[Belsmuth system/Legends|Belsmuth]], [[Katraasii system/Legends|Katraasii]], [[New Bornalex system/Legends|New Bornalex]], and [[Shadren system/Legends|Shadren systems]] as well as the [[Phindar system/Legends|Phindar system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] also shared its name with the [[Solaest Fleet Long Range Patrol Wing]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Sourcebook2">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

The Solaest system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Solaest|same name]].<ref name="CSWE" /> At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Solaest was the site of the [[Solaest Uprising]], which was suppressed by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the Empire<ref name="CSWE" /> as part of its wider attempts to crack down on the activities of its enemy during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The uprising resulted in extensive civilian [[Death/Legends|casualties]]. During the uprising, the Solaest system was also visited by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senator]] and secret Alliance member [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on her [[CR90 corvette/Legends|consular starship]], the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].<ref name="TEA" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Solaest system was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article placed the system in the [[Fringe Territories]].<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The first canonical mention of the Solaes system in ''Star Wars'' Legends was in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA" />
